title: Genesis Engine Machine-Readable Function Catalog
purpose: Requirements baseline and source-reconciliation register for the general-purpose Genesis Engine.
rules: Do not claim a function exists until an exact source symbol is mapped.
Do not mark IMPLEMENTED without source and tests at an exact SHA.
Do not mark VERIFIED without exact-SHA workflow run, job, step, exit code and logs/artifact.
Unmapped runtime symbols and catalog requirements block completeness.
Document exclusions with rationale and evidence; do not silently omit symbols.
Keep engine generic; Genesis Chronicles integration belongs in a separate consumer repository.
Do not add engine gameplay rules that are specific to Genesis Chronicles.
